title: Thai-Spiced Carrot Burgers
changes_from_base: Meat-free: grated carrot softened with spring onion, ginger, chilli, coriander, turmeric and cinnamon, bound with egg white, peanut butter and lime, crumbed, browned and finished in the oven.
summary: Tender grated carrots are spiced with warm turmeric and cinnamon, bound with peanut butter and fresh coriander into fragrant, golden patties.

ingredients.item: spring onions, thinly sliced (with 2-3 cm of the green)
serrano or other green chilli, finely chopped
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Heat
steps.text: Warm 1 tbsp of 45 ml olive oil in a large lidded sauté pan over medium heat and cook 6 thinly sliced spring onions (with 2-3 cm of the green) for about 2 min until starting to soften.

steps.title: Aromatics
steps.text: Add 3 finely chopped garlic cloves, 15 g finely grated fresh ginger and 1 finely chopped serrano or other green chilli and stir for 30 s until fragrant.

steps.title: Carrots
steps.text: Stir in 440 g coarsely grated carrots (about 8 medium), 1 tsp fine salt, 1 tsp ground coriander, ¾ tsp ground turmeric and ½ tsp ground cinnamon; cover and cook 6-8 min until soft but not mushy.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Whisk 2 large egg whites, 2 tbsp smooth unsweetened peanut butter and 1 tbsp lime juice in a bowl; stir in the carrot mix and 10 g roughly chopped coriander, then fold in 55 g toasted dried breadcrumbs and leave 10 min for the crumbs to soak up the liquid; adjust seasoning and shape 4 patties.

steps.title: Brown
steps.text: Heat the remaining 2 tbsp oil in an ovenproof non-stick frying pan over medium-high and brown the patties 2-3 min a side.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Transfer to the oven at 190 °C (170 °C fan) and bake 12-15 min until firm and cooked through (71 °C in the centre).

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Place in 4 burger buns or serve on their own.

tips: Toast breadcrumbs in a dry pan to deepen flavour before folding in.
Grate carrots just before cooking to keep them bright and firm.
Freeze uncooked patties on a tray, then bag once solid—they freeze exceptionally well.
storage: Cooked patties last 3 days refrigerated and reheat gently in a low oven for 10 minutes. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
